replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA involves turning a set of variables into a new set of uncorrelated variables called principal components. First, you standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix. Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Sort them by size and pick the top few. Those are your principal components. The math can be intimidating, but you don’t need to understand every part to use it.
